name: GreenThumb Garden Info
description:
This dataset contains records for 635 New York City community gardens, with one row per garden and 27 columns. Each record identifies the garden by name, street address, cross streets, ZIP code, borough, and neighborhood tabulation area, and includes geographic coordinates and a polygon boundary for mapping. Administrative and political fields cover community board, assembly, congressional, council, state senate, and police precinct districts, plus census tract and BBL property identifiers. Operational fields include the garden's jurisdiction (such as Parks, DOT, or NYCHA), its GreenThumb status (for example Active, Inactive, or Not GreenThumb), a Parks Department ID, and opening hours broken out by day of the week. Some fields have notable gaps: hours are missing for roughly 35–46% of rows depending on the day, and coordinates, census tract, and cross streets are missing for about 8–9%.

The data supports mapping garden locations and comparing access across neighborhoods and districts, analyzing when
